== Notes ==
* Unlike [[Distracting Strike]], no damage [[packet]] is displayed when hitting the target.
** [[Barbs]], and the damage increase from [[Soul Taker]], [[Order of Pain]], [[Strength of Honor]], and [[Conjures]] will not trigger.
* A hit is still registered on the target:
** [[Adrenaline]] (and [[energy]] if using a [[Zealous]] weapon modifier) is gained as usual. 
** [[Scythe]] attacks will hit up to two additional adjacent foes (interrupting them and foes adjacent to them).
** Adrenaline gain from [[Mark of Fury]] and [[Dark Fury]], [[Blood Bond]]'s healing, and [[Soul Taker]]'s [[health sacrifice]] will occur.
** Life stealing from a [[Vampiric]] weapon modifier, [[Avatar of Grenth]], [[Grenth's Aura]] and [[Order of the Vampire]] will occur.
** [[Splinter Weapon]] will trigger.
** Distracting Blow needs to hit for its interruption to occur. If Distracting Blow [[miss]]es (due to [[blind]] for instance) or the user is under the effects of [[Illusionary Weaponry]], the interruption will not occur. 
{{Anomaly| The concise description is incorrect: the adjacent foes are interrupted but not attacked. Notably, you won't gain adrenaline from them, and Illusionary Weaponry will not damage them (unless wielding a scythe).}}
